Title: JYHAD: Can you attack a tapped vampire?

Messages.Author: Jay Elmore
Messages.Body:
OK. Archon is a political action that, if passed, gives a vampire the 
ability to attack other vampires as a (D) action.

What happens if I attack a vampire that is tapped (say, my predator's 
vampire)? Can the tapped vampire defend itself?

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Jay Elmore <jelmore@netcom.com> wrote:
>OK. Archon is a political action that, if passed, gives a vampire the 
>ability to attack other vampires as a (D) action.
>What happens if I attack a vampire that is tapped (say, my predator's 
>vampire)? Can the tapped vampire defend itself?

Any minion in play can fight in combat just fine, regardless of what
state it's in (though it's difficult if not impossible to force a vampire
in torpor into combat).  Tapped minions cannot act, block, or react,
but they can fight just fine.
